requirements.statement: Query, JSON body and form models given to validate() or as view annotations are parsed and exposed on request and as keyword arguments; annotated path parameters are converted.
Repeated query keys fill List fields; request_body_many validates an array into models and rejects a non-array body with a root error; get_json_params is passed to request.get_json.

Validation failures return {validation_error: {<group>: [...]}} with status 400 or the configured status; each item has a loc list, msg and type, and custom validator messages appear in msg; the raise option raises flask_pydantic.ValidationError with the same groups.

Returned models are serialized with on_success_status and application/json; exclude_none and response_by_alias are honored; response_many serializes iterables and raises InvalidIterableOfModelsException otherwise; status/header tuples apply; other values pass through.
The same behavior holds when only Pydantic moves from 1.10.15 to 2.6.4 with the rest of the lock unchanged; only Python modules under flask_pydantic/ change.
